label: For "HVAC Energy Optimisation": Control heating and cooling setpoints to cut energy use while keeping comfort within limits. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: A simulator that does not match the real building gives gains that vanish on site.
